name: AI Usage
subtitle: AI limits and usage widgets
platform: macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon
description:
See AI usage on your Mac, right on your desktop. Connect a tool’s local history to see recorded requests, tokens, and estimated API value for today, the last week, or the last month.

The setup guide walks you through Claude Code, Codex and Google Antigravity. Choose the tools and history folders you want to include. AI Usage reads them with your permission and shares only summary numbers with its widgets. No dashboard or separate server is required.

See ChatGPT account limits by signing in with OpenAI, or use recent limit readings from a Codex session. For Claude limits, paste the setup request into Claude Code and send a message. The app shows when a reading arrives. Google Antigravity history supplies usage totals. Connect Google quota to see the remaining percentages and reset times reported by the Antigravity desktop app on this Mac.

Add AI plan limits or AI usage totals from the macOS widget gallery. Preview both with fictional data in Demo, or connect your own AI Usage dashboard if you already run one. API value is an estimate, not a bill.

AI Usage is an independent app.
reviewNotes: Open AI Usage. On a clean Mac the guide opens to Choose tools. Select Preview with sample data to review without any accounts or history, then Control-click the desktop, select Edit Widgets and search for AI Usage. Both widgets label sample readings. To try local setup, choose Set up this Mac in Settings. Choose tools, then connect any combination of history and quota. Connect history uses macOS’s read-only folder picker. Claude Code offers a setup request to paste into its built-in /statusline command. ChatGPT offers sign-in. Connect Google quota reads percentages and reset times from the installed, signed-in Antigravity desktop app. macOS asks for its daemon folder once when history permission is unavailable. No separate dashboard or Terminal command is required. Returning users manage connections in Settings. Advanced retains Demo and the optional user-provided dashboard.
